name: Control Components, Inc
old_description: Thank you for visiting Control Components! For 35 years our company has specialized in providing a broad range of factory automation and machine safety solution products from leading manufacturers for the Automotive, Industrial, OEM, and Systems Integrator markets.
about:
Control Components, Inc. operates from Pelham, Alabama, where it has spent 35 years supplying factory automation and machine safety products to industrial customers. The company is organized as an Alabama corporation and makes clear that it is not affiliated with the California-based IMI Critical Engineering, which also uses the CCI name. No founding year or individual founders are disclosed in public materials.

The business functions as an authorized distributor rather than a manufacturer. Its line card spans sensors (inductive, photoelectric, ultrasonic, limit switches), machine safety (light curtains, scanners, mats, relays, interlock switches), control panel devices (timers, relays, contactors, circuit breakers, terminal blocks, pushbuttons), industrial communication (Ethernet switches), and process measurement instruments. Staff described as factory-trained assist customers in selecting what the company calls the most cost-effective products for each application.

Primary markets include automotive, general industrial, original equipment manufacturers, and systems integrators. The distributor holds authorized status for brands such as ABB, GE, IDEC, Eaton Cutler-Hammer, Balluff, Pepperl+Fuchs, Schmersal, and dozens of others listed across its catalog.

The company emphasizes technical support and breadth of inventory as its basis for competition, positioning its trained personnel as a resource for matching components to application requirements.
